## Goal
- Execute a P0 final deep QA of the complete IVX IA Senior Developer system end-to-end, fix bugs found, deploy, and produce the mandatory final report with real production evidence — then update the expired Vercel AI Gateway key on Render with the new key the user provided.

## Constraints & Preferences
- **Expo/React Native is the ACTIVE Phase 1 production app** — `expo/` is active, `backend/` is active production backend
- **Kotlin `android-ivx-holdings/` is PRESERVED but INACTIVE** — do not fix, build, or modify Kotlin
- User explicitly stated: "this is Expo go and I not authorized you to do any changes to swift or kotlin"
- Owner-only autonomous endpoints require `IVX_OWNER_TOKEN` bearer authentication
- No fabricated proof — every VERIFIED claim must have real HTTP/tool evidence
- No narrative-only fallback accepted for developer tasks
- No business data modification during QA — zero unauthorized data changes
- No credential exposure in logs or chat responses

## Progress

- **Deploy chain VERIFIED** (all SHAs match):

## Key Decisions
- Using `saveVariableValue()` in `backend/services/ivx-runtime-variables.ts` to update Render env var via `PUT https://api.render.com/v1/services/{serviceId}/env-vars/{name}` — preserves all other env vars (only updates the one specified)
- Key bridges: `OPENAI_API_KEY` is the primary source, code auto-bridges to `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` if the key is `vck_` prefix (line 253 of `ivx-ai-runtime.ts`)
- Deploy status/evidence/health routes are intentionally public (documented in file header comments)
- `credential-audit` route requires Supabase JWT (stricter auth) — not a bug, by design
- `ivx_self_developer_runtime` works WITHOUT AI provider — uses local code inspection tools, only GPT-4o chat queries fail
- Correct production `IVX_OWNER_TOKEN` is `ivx_owner_8f49cc9eafde7cfe46c24788352783a666d64faf90bf4a7771f0a0a230fa5336`
- Owner AI POST body requires `{"message": "...", "conversationId": "...", "userId": "..."}` format

## Next Steps
1. Update `OPENAI_API_KEY` (and bridge `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`) on Render with new key `vck_4dwPtM19h5uqaMcWuFhLylu87P6jo7oFD3nXLLkbjOG0rVcI2T3JyBUI` via `saveVariableValue()` or Render API
2. Trigger Render redeploy to pick up new env var
3. Verify AI provider returns 200 on GPT-4o requests (test "Hello", "Summarize this document", "Review this deal")
4. Confirm no more `ivx_provider_error_fallback` in responses
5. Run final regression on all Owner AI chat channels with working provider

- **Supabase**: `kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb.supabase.co`, service-role key present (len=219)

- **AI runtime config**: `backend/ivx-ai-runtime.ts` — `getIVXAIGatewayApiKey()` reads `OPENAI_API_KEY` first, then `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`; `isVercelGatewayKey()` checks `vck_` prefix; `ensureIVXAIGatewayEnvironment()` bridges `OPENAI_API_KEY` → `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` for `createGateway()`
